caseName: Atlantic Coast Line Railroad v. Dutton
caseNameFull: Atlantic Coast Line Railroad Company, in Error v. Ella Dutton, as Administratrix of the Estate of Lee Dutton
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of South Carolina.
attorneys: Mr. P. A. Willcox, Mr. Lucian W. McLemore, Mr. Frederic D. McKenney and Mr. J. S. Flannery for plaintiff in error., Mr. L. D. Jennings and Mr. A. S. Harby for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with costs upon the authority of Chicago Junction Ry. Co. v. King, 222 U. S. 222; Seaboard Air Line Ry. v. Padgett, 236 U. S. 668; Great Northern Ry. Co. v. Knapp, 240 U. S. 464; Baltimore & Ohio R. R. Co. v. Whitacre, 242 U. S. 169; Southern Ry. Co. v. Puckett, 244 U. S. 571, 574.
